item.description: Charlton and Queens Park Rangers faced off on Friday night with London bragging rights, as well as vital points at stake. item.title: Sky Bet League Two Round-Up: Bromley maintain five-point gap with late winner
item.description: Jude Arthurs scored a stoppage-time winner as Sky Bet League Two leaders Bromley came from behind to beat Fleetwood Town. Mark Helm had put the hosts ahead before substitute Nicke Kabamba equalised, with Arthurs turning in Damola Ajayi’s cross late on to seal the win and maintain their five-point gap at the summit. item.title: Sky Bet League One Round-Up: Top two win and Luton close the gap to Play-Off spots
item.description: Ten-man Cardiff City stayed top of the table with a 3-0 win over struggling Rotherham United. Omari Kellyman, Chris Willock, and Isaak Davies scored, with Ryan Wintle’s early red card failing to stop the Bluebirds from maintaining their lead at the summit of Sky Bet League One. item.title: Sky Bet Championship Round-Up: Leaders drop points as Ipswich close the gap
item.description: Coventry City’s winless run extended to three matches as they were held to a goalless draw by Oxford United. Will Lankshear was sent off late for the visitors, but the Championship leaders could not take advantage, giving Middlesbrough the chance to overtake them if they win at Sheffield United on Monday night.
